context: Hina-young recommends her favorite manga to Aoi.
purpose: Teen sharing pop-culture enthusiasm with adult mentor.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 蒼さん、この漫画、面白い!
lines.en: Aoi, this manga is so good!
lines.style: Bright, unguarded enthusiasm. Quick attack on the opening — she's bursting to share. Warm and animated throughout. The innocent certainty of an eight-year-old recommending something she loves.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Soft, genuinely curious. A warm adult tone leaning in to listen. Gentle pace — she's not just asking, she's showing interest.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: The main character is super strong!
lines.style: Quick, animated momentum. Words tumble out with excitement. Bright and unfiltered — she's painting the picture for Aoi to see.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Ha, I'll have to read it then.
lines.style: Soft, warm laugh on the opening. Gentle and fond. The tone of an adult who means what she says — she's genuinely going to read it because this child matters to her.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: You're totally going to love it!
lines.style: Confident, bright conviction. Slight lean forward in the voice — she's sure about this. Warm and unironic. The certainty of a child who knows something important.
